Hi Alex —

Great meeting you at MLConf last week. Really enjoyed the conversation about how FinTechX is looking to bring real-time risk-scoring into production — especially your notes on 200ms p95 latency targets and wanting to keep unit cost under $0.0006/token for high-throughput scoring.

Recap of what we discussed:
- Primary goal: real-time model inference for risk scoring across web and mobile.
- Traffic profile: bursty daily peaks, average 75 reqs/sec with spikes to 1.2k.
- Constraints: PCI-adjacent data, procurement timeline, and a tight cost target.

Next steps I suggested:
1) Short technical deep-dive / demo (30 min) to show latency profiles on Dedicated capacity + batching/kv-cache strategies.
2) Share a short SOW + typical pricing ranges for Dedicated vs Hosted on bursty workloads.
3) Loop in procurement if the SOW looks reasonable.

I'm attaching the deck we walked through (redwood-inference-deck.pdf) and a simple runbook for demo prep. If any of the above priorities changed since the conference, let me know. Otherwise, here are a couple of slots open this week:
- Wed 9/22 10:00-10:30 PT
- Thu 9/23 13:00-13:30 PT

Or pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/demo-30

Thanks — would love to get a quick follow-up scheduled and share a draft SOW.

Best,
